entry.note: Verified against NUMDAM / SMF Astérisque 61 (1979), pp. 11-13.

relevance.rationale: Landmark irrationality proof for zeta(2) and zeta(3) exhibiting rational approximants whose exponential decay overcomes lcm(1..n)^2 and lcm(1..n)^3 denominator growth.

keyResults.locator: pp. 11-13 (3-term holonomic recurrences for zeta(2) and zeta(3))
keyResults.statement: Constructs explicit integer-recurrence rational approximants p_n / q_n with q_n = O(lcm(1..n)^3) beating Liouville's d = 1 bound for zeta(3).
keyResults.useForFolio: Benchmark for the weight-2 denominator-growth wall measured in four_one_volume_transcendence_error_bounds_probe.py.
